roles: target-year Y: train through Y-2; selection Y-1; evaluation Y; origins embargoed at the previous role target end
cohort: Known non-excess at origin T, exact-calendar known onset labels, known count at T+h and complete canonical ON allowlist; identical OFF/ON and full R0 evaluation keys, no intersection substitution
transforms: Fixed EXITO/SEGURIDAD/ALERTA/EXCESO coding 0/1/2/3; log1p of count and P25/P50/P75 features; training-only population mean/std, constant scale 1; no imputation or future fitting

model.failure: Nonconvergence or nonfinite distribution fails; no evaluation-driven retry or retuning
model.matrix: One pooled direct marginal per horizon, year and climate OFF/ON: 16 unique fits; no search

distribution.excess_risk: scipy.stats.nbinom.sf(floor(origin-safe P75 H5 for target month), r, p); strict count>P75
distribution.onset_t1: excess risk on the observed non-excess-at-T cohort
distribution.onset_t2: NO_EVALUABLE: direct marginals do not identify a coherent joint T+1/T+2 transition distribution; never substitute excess or observed future state
distribution.interval_interpretation: Discrete central predictive interval conditional on fitted parameters; not a parameter confidence interval

policy.reference: R0 on identical complete keys and truths
policy.adoption: Mauricio explicitly adopted application to EXP-BETA02 in the Phase 3 request before any fit
policy.selection: Reuse whole-tie maximum detections under budget on previous selection-year scores only; prefer fewer false alerts and then higher threshold; no-alert fallback
policy.guardrails: Report every year and Meta/Tolima/all stratum; no evaluation-selected climate setting
policy.inference: Descriptive compliance is not statistical noninferiority; statistical NI UNAVAILABLE and superiority NOT_ESTABLISHED without independent support

secondary_beta01.use: Optional unchanged scores/alerts, exact full cohort pairing, secondary context only

neural_candidate: NO_EVALUABLE: no predeclared independent sequential-model justification; limited reused evaluation years and no identified deficiency warranting a neural fit before this baseline
profiles: NO_EVALUABLE: no validated canonical transmission-profile field
confirmation: None. All years retrospective; 2024 consumed stress, no 2025 targets, fitting or evaluation; no champion selection
hypothesis_rule: Any T1 year/department sensitivity/load failure rejects this fixed marginal approach for the joint objective. Otherwise NO_EVALUABLE because T2 onset and independent inferential support are unavailable. Better count error alone never establishes better outbreak detection.
